messages:
sam: Heads up — canary after the kernel-selector tweak is showing intermittent 200–400ms p95 spikes. I pulled an nsys trace and there's a tight burst of small cudaMalloc/free calls around KV cache misses that wasn't there before. :eyes:

lina: Link? perfetto or nsys capture would help. suspecting allocator churn but could be kernel path change too.

sam: perfetto link: https://perfetto.app/trace/abc123 (nvprof+nvtx). nsys capture saved as /tmp/nsys_kv_smallalloc.qdrep. Quick snippet from the timeline: a 3–5 alloc/free pair per request, grouped right before kernel launch.

chen: can you paste the nsys filter you used? also which kernel-selector commit?

sam: selector @fd3a2b — changed heuristic to prefer fused attention kernel for batch_size<=32. nsys command I used:

```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,cudnn -o kvsmall /path/to/bin --args
nsys stats kvsmall.qdrep
```

Output (filtered):
```
CUDA API: cudaMalloc  x  4 calls  (avg 0.9ms each)
CUDA Kernel launches  x  6 calls
Wall time window where allocs cluster: 12.4ms
```

maria: interesting — when selector chose fused kernel for small batches it increased temporary kv-cache allocations because fused path wants contiguous buffers and we fall back to host-pinned for alignment. That causes the cudaMalloc spikes.

aj: Logs from canary: "kvcache: miss -> allocate tmp buf -> kernel -> free" loop repeated 3x for ~30% of requests, correlates with p99 latency.

lina: quick mitigation ideas:
- widen the kernel-selector threshold so small batches use the old tiled kernel (avoid extra contiguous allocs)
- bump arena slab size to reduce fragmentation
- enable a short-lived KV temp pool to reuse these ephemeral buffers

chen: I ran a microbenchmark: changed selector cutoff 32->24 and added a small temp-pool (64KB slab, 256 slabs). Result: cudaMalloc calls dropped 82%, median latency unchanged, p95 dropped ~210ms. Raw numbers:

```
before: p95=420ms, cudaMalloc spikes=3.1/request
after:  p95=210ms, cudaMalloc spikes=0.5/request
```

sam: huge win. let's roll this to canary with runtime flags (selector-cutoff=24 + kv.temp_pool_enabled=true). Also add NVTX markers around allocator hotpath so traces are easier.

maria: agree. open a follow-up to track a longer-term fix: either make fused kernel allocate from pre-reserved pool or change fused kernel to be less demanding on alignment. I'll add benchmarking for sequence lengths 8/32/128.

sam: created GH issue #2387 (kvcache/temp-pool + selector heuristic tuning). assigning to eng-runtime. I'll kick off a canary deploy now.

ops-bot: deploy/canary started by sam — id: deploy-2026-03-10-09-12. :rocket:

lina: after canary verifies we should add an automatic regression alert that triggers when cudaMalloc count/request > 0.5 for 5m. saved us today. :thumbsup:

chen: also adding an automated perfetto snapshot for any canary that flips kernel-selector flag so we have before/after traces.

sam: thanks team — I'll post follow-up once canary stabilizes.
